name: DAMIC-M
notes: No official DAMIC-M website was found; no website is recorded rather than a guessed one.

The full-scale final DAMIC-M detector (beyond the 20 g Low Background Chamber prototype) is described in earlier planning documents as a much larger kg-scale array; no source consulted confirms it is yet installed or operating, so only the prototype's status is recorded.

physics_goals.quote: A novel skipper readout implemented in the CCDs provides single electron resolution through multiple non-destructive measurements of the individual pixel charge ... in particular of candidates pertaining to the so-called “hidden sector.”
value: Search for sub-GeV/hidden-sector dark matter via single-electron ionization signals in skipper CCDs

summary.plain: DAMIC-M is the next generation of the DAMIC dark matter search, using very sensitive silicon chips called skipper CCDs that can count single electrons. A 20-gram prototype has been running deep under a mountain in the French Alps since 2022, hunting for very light, hidden particles.
summary.technical: Skipper-CCD dark matter search at the Laboratoire Souterrain de Modane (LSM); a 20 g 'Low Background Chamber' prototype has been operating since 2022, most recently reporting a 1.257 kg-day analysed exposure (Nov 2025) setting improved constraints on sub-MeV hidden-sector dark matter via a daily-modulation search. Successor in name and technology to DAMIC at SNOLAB.

unique_capabilities.quote: A novel skipper readout implemented in the CCDs provides single electron resolution through multiple non-destructive measurements of the individual pixel charge, pushing the detection threshold to the eV-scale.
value: Skipper-CCD readout giving single-electron charge resolution with eV-scale ionization thresholds
